name: Software development cycle
description: A request walks the full development cycle, with a persona owning each stage: product-manager writes the requirements → startup-CTO designs the architecture (reading your workspace code) → a design-review PANEL (backend-engineer and devops-engineer in parallel, devil's-advocate attacking their takes in step 2, compiled to a verdict) → YOUR sign-off → implementation with write access → run the test suite → fix-and-retest loop until green → independent code review → devops release-readiness check → one dev dossier. Shows: persona-per-stage, orchestrate as a design-review board, approval gate, write-access tiers, run_tests, a loop-back edge (bounded by the run's visit cap — cancel from the jobs popup if it thrashes). Point it at a project living in your workspace.

input.label: What to build
input.placeholder: e.g. add CSV export to the reports page of workspace/myapp

nodes.text:
Turn this request into crisp requirements: the user story, scope (explicitly in and out), and 3-6 testable acceptance criteria.

Request: {{input}}

nodes.label: build review
ops review
devil's advocate

nodes.text: Compile the panel into a design-review verdict: blockers that MUST change before implementation, improvements worth making, and what's green-lit as-is.

nodes.prompt:
Architecture + design-review verdict are in — approve and start implementation?

{{node.7}}

nodes.text: Compile the development dossier as Markdown: requirements ({{node.2}}), the architecture's key decisions ({{node.3}}), the design-review verdict ({{node.7}}), final test status ({{node.10}}), code-review findings ({{node.13}}), and the release-readiness checklist ({{node.14}}). End with a ship / hold recommendation and the three next actions.

args.title: 🚢 Dev cycle
